# PHOTODYNAMIC THERAPY AND LASER SKIN RESURFACING HSV-1 PROPHYLAXIS

Recommended in patients with history of HSV-1 infection. Initiate prophylaxis 24-48 hours prior to surgery and continue for 3-7 days.

[Acyclovir 400 mg PO BID for 5 days \($\) R](psjzid-acyclovir-400mg-po-bid)
